chunks: Who hears the cry of the anguished (soul) when it calls to Him, and relieves its suffering? And who made you trustees on the earth? Is there any other god along with God? How little it is that you reflect!
ai.seo_question: What are the key attributes of God mentioned in Surah An-Naml verse 62?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Allah’s absolute sovereignty by contrasting His responsive mercy with the impotence of idols, particularly emphasizing the concept of 'Khalifa' (vicegerency) as a divine trust granted to humanity. The rhetorical structure serves to awaken spiritual reflection, reminding believers that true deliverance from distress comes solely from the One who establishes earthly authority, a theme central to understanding divine justice and human responsibility.
